nom: The Ordinary Pycnogenol 5% Antioxidant for Environmental Protection

avis.texte: I get severe eczema on my feet. My toes will swell up and I then have trouble walking. prescription strength steroids did nothing. I used this for the first time during a really bad flare up, there was a huge difference in just 24 hours. in about 3 days, you couldn't even tell. now I use this before bed as a preventative measure.

avis.titre: What have you done to me
avis.texte: I dont think I can live without this product. I've used it for several years and I can confidently say my aging (37 yo) skin has looked like crap when I've run out and had to go (briefly) without it. I have sensitive, acne proned, oily skin; this product has never aggravated it. It's perfection in a bottle and I will go out kicking and swinging if anything ever changes about it.

avis.titre: Gives your skin a healthy glow!
avis.texte: I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. Pycnogenol is one of my favorite products. Not only does it moisturize, it gives my skin a healthy, golden glow. I instantly feel like I look several years younger after using this. Beware though, it will stain your clothes and fingers, so wash your hands after. Follow it with Amino Acids.

avis.titre: my skin breaking out from this
avis.texte: my skin breaking out with this, and ULTA makes it impossible to exchange or refund...i wont buy from them again .The service is not up to standard.

i dont know what anybody else uses but this hasnt left a sticky residue on my face ever. This also if not the last step in my skin care routine and I apply it before other oils and moisturizers. I use this daily and nightly and it does wonders!

avis.titre: Works on a recurring winter rash on my hand
avis.texte: I have a strange rash on my middle knuckle of only my right hand and only in winter for 10 years. It worsens in the cold and with handwashing. Lotion and vaseline helps, but does not eliminate. I tried pycogenol yesterday and the rash is almost gone.

avis.titre: Protecting my skin from outside things
avis.texte: I usually applied it before i do my makeup , it goes well with my makeup foundation , make the look very natural like your real skin . But if you use it on day time , you need to apply sunscreen on .
It's moisturizing and makes my skin look glassy all day after applying. It has given my skin a youthful appearance. I love it!

Yes, this is sticky on its own so i have left this on my face for 30 min before my next layer but really doesn't make a difference. I now add this to my moisturizer prior to my SS. I was using this in place if Vit C as i wanted to use my copper serum. I now use this almiat everyday because the stickiness has disappeared when combined with my moisturizer. This is much more powerful as an antioxidant.

I wanted SO badly to love this, since the reviews have been so positive. I struggle with adult-onset acne, and I have a pretty good routine that keeps breakouts at bay. However, my skin can look pretty dull as a result. Most antioxidants I've tried, including Vitamin C, have only clogged my pores or not fit in well with my other products. But I really wanted something to help brighten my skin up after exfoliants. Sadly, this goes in with all the other brightening products I've tried. It's too sticky, makes my sunscreen pill, and just made me break out all over again. I quit using after a week. Yes, I know some products cause cell turnover and that can cause breakouts temporarily, but in my experience, those breakouts never stopped even after weeks of using. Just not willing to risk it again. Very happy it works for others, but if you have combination-oily skin like me, be cautious with tacky, oil-like products.

I have struggled with this condition since post partum. Usually just a flare when weeding or planting in the spring. However for some reason I have been struggling with it on 1 finger for three months. Nothing has given consistent relief or resolved the flair. I read a reddit comment that mentioned this and saw a review on here referencing it too. I bought it that day (3 days ago) and it has been amazing how quick this has given relief and decreased the flair. I am sooo glad I found this and thankful that others shared its benefit!!! If you struggle with this condition I HIGHLY recommend giving it a try.

Ive been working on finding the right combination of products for my skin for years and I think I finally found my routine. This has made a huge difference. I've had acne in different areas for about 17 years and my skin is clearer than its ever been. I noticed my skin looked brighter and plumper within a few days. I noticed I was developing fine lines on my forehead and within a few weeks of starting to use this, they were no longer visible. I'm so pleased with the clarity and brightness of my skin since using this and it is well worth the price.
I absolutely love,love ,love this mini sweet product,love how it feels,how it smells,how beneficial is for my dry skin..10/10😘

Great product I am 73 and use everyday I have no lines or wrinkles since I started all the products .I use glycolic acid 7 % that I start with and then arg. Then pycnogenol . As I said no lines at 73 yrs. Note used products for years.

It brightens my skin, which got a little dry and dull during winter. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy and absorbs quickly. However, my cat likes it as well and attempts to lick my face every time I use it.

I'm a tretinoin user, and this stuff is a miracle find. I love the way it smells, and more than any other serum I've used it has eliminated any dry patches, and hydrated my dry skin. Simply amazing! I went without it a few days and definitely noticed a difference. It's a keeper!
I wanted to love this but I think it may be too heavy for my skin. Caused really bad breakouts.

I LOVE this product My skin was already pretty good with my the ordinary regimen, but after seeing Cassandra's video I've decided to add this molecule and good lord what am I happy!! It really gave my skin that extra it needed! After two weeks you start seeing results for sure!
I wanted to love it..Based on all the good reviews I had hoped it would work for me, but it made me break out after just a couple of days.

I don't use many of The Ordinary products, but Pycnogenol is one that I always have in my routine. I use it in the morning mixed in with my moisturizer. It gives my skin this beautiful glow. I've noticed that my skin is beginning to look firmer and more plumped. The smell doesn't bother me. I've stocked up during SlowNovember.

I'm not a review writer type of person, but this product is worth it. I pair it with the vit c 23% and as soon as it touches my skin, I feel it plumper, brighter and more hydrated. Really amazing. I finish with the HA moisturizer and sunscreen, and I don't even feel the need to wear makeup, I get a glass skin with this regimen. Just 15ml, but 2 drops are enough for the full face, so considering it's good for just 6 months after opening, I'm glad I won't be discarding any product at the end.

My friends: 2 drops of this mixed with 4 drops of rosehip seed oil before bed and I looked like effing Aurora in the morning, as if I'd just woken up from ALL the beauty sleep. I do love the Ordinary in general, but this is my new top-top miracle product.

Have used this product for over a year now. After trying and testing the best results for me are when I mix one drop with my moisturizer in the AM. Gives me enough of a healthy glow. More than one drop results in pilling and break outs.

I love pycnogel! Initially, I wasn't crazy about the feel of it on my skin. It felt a little warm and sticky on my sensitive skin—even a tiny bit irritating. However, I decided to give it another chance after trying it on a patch of terribly sunburned skin in the center of my back that recovered overnight—the redness and pain disappeared completely. After gradually working up to using it on my face regularly, now it actually feels nice on my skin. I usually use it at night (and occasionally in the morning) either on its own or mixed with Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA and/or 100% L-Ascorbic Acid Powder. It makes a noticeable difference in my over 50 skin. My face feels significantly less dry, and it looks smoother and more more moisturized. Also, I'm often super sensitive to added fragrances, but I like the smell of pycnogel.

It was obvious to me that this product was not for me. I did a patch test on the bottom of my cheek and it went well. The next day, I used it lightly on my entire face and after 30 minutes it was bothersome. I looked in the mirror and I had bumps and blotches on my face so I washed it off. Next day face was fine. Two days later, I wanted to try it one more time but an even lighter cost and only on certain parts of my face, cheeks and forehead. 30 minutes later and it was so blotchy I decided this is not for me.

avis.titre: The product you need for your dry skin
avis.texte: I recommend it for dry skin! I can see the difference when I use this product, my skin seems more nourished, plumper and healthier. I would buy again!

I applied this product all over my face. My forehead looks great, no redness or swelling, the skin is moisturized. But my cheeks and nose turned into a tomato: the skin was very red and swelling appeared. This lasted for several hours. There was such an incomprehensible reaction on my face. I'm confused, I don't know if I should try applying it again to the lower part of my face?!

I have dyshidrotic eczema and I am so grateful for the one review I found on this product while Googling. It's the one topical that helps with flares. As long as I resist scratching and picking, the Pycnogenol dries the bumps without totally drying out my hands. If I apply it before the flare really starts, the bumps don't even form or the few that do can be gone in a day or two and my skin doesn't crack at all. I use the hyaluronic acid serum after the bumps start to dry to add a little moisture to my skin without over moisturizing and bringing the bumps back. This product has been a life saver and I desperately wish it was carried in stores!

Hate to give it a bad review but this product is extremely finicky on sensitive skin. And I personally don't even have sensitive skin, mine can handle a lot but this unfortunately burned. I could only use this by babying it and mixing it with something else and ultimately decided I would not continue to use it due to the irritation, my whole face would get red and flushed. It smelled great (like pine) and has a great texture but I just couldn't tolerate it. I think tretinoin just sensitized my skin to this too much and I advise anyone else on tretinoin to not use this, try The Ordinary's Ascorbyl Glucoside 12% instead which is very gentle and pairs well with the tretinoin.

I tried a month without using pycnogenol topically and taking pills orally (Do Not Swallow This, I said I Took Pills!) After a month without this one ingredient, I have super damaged, inflamed, papule-ridden skin. Never going without this stuff again! I have a mast cell disorder, and pycnogenol stabilizes mast cells. There aren't many studies, so I was skeptical and tried leaving it out of my routine without changing anything else. I'm anecdotally convinced now hahaha

I bought the product based on reviews without any expectations. I've only been using it a few weeks. I apply it after cleansing and before using Good Molecules squalane oil. It has an unpleasant odor that reminds me of apple cider vinegar and is an orange/brown colored oil. The odor doesn't last and the color doesn't stain your skin. I only needed 4 to 5 drops for my entire face and neck. Four people have commented on my skin this past week, out of the blue. I am 59. Do I have perfect skin, no, but my skin texture looks greatly improved. It is smoother and my skin looks hydrated and plump. I can definitely tell a difference. I love skin care and have tried many expensive products. I had to try the The Ordinary pycnogenol based on the rating. I am going to continue to use it because my skin looks better than ever! Plus, the price, wow!!!

My dry + dehydrated skin lovessss this!!! It's such an amazing antioxidant for the skin! Its red and kinda feels a little warm when you apply and it just makes it feel even more hydrated and wonderful! My skin glows with this

I've always been skeptical when it comes to skincare. My skin is so bipolar!! (just like me 😂😭) For a week, it will love a product, and then completely break out because of it. I've unfortunately inherited a nasty acne gene and have never been able to fully clear up my acne. but this product…. holy wow 😍 i bought my first bottle maybe 2-4 (too many separate ulta trips to remember which one 😂) and it's definitely my favorite product ive ever purchased; just went and reordered another last night. i pair it with the glycolic acid toner and my favorite moisturizer. for the first time i can say my skin is glowinggg ✨ i can honeslty say this product has been doing its work because ive been getting so many complements on my makeup (specifically my base makeup) and i havent changed anything about my routine. i just wish it came in a bigger size so i didnt have to reorder so soon!!

This product makes a visible difference (softening and making skin more youthful) more quickly than any other TO product I've tried. I don"t apply directly - for years I've used Curel fragrance free regular lotion on my face - ever since finding it was great at keeping my hands from cracking during Michigan winters. The lotion works great for face too, so I mix 3-4 drops of pycnogenol with it, then apply. So easy and no stickiness issues. I also use with vitamin c mixed in. My sister now uses pycnogenol all the time too. A top 3 product for me - highly recommend!

avis.titre: This is my new favorite product
avis.texte: I've been using this product every other day in the PM for about a week now, and I have noticed such a difference in my skin. I have had very stubborn acne for years, and due to stress I had dull and dry skin and also had some slight fine lines on my forehead which would crease when i'd put makeup on. I woke up this morning and looked in the mirror and I was shocked to see that my skin is now mostly clear except for a few fading acne scars and one almost healed pimple on my chin. My skin is also hydrated, plump, and looks much more fresh and alive! I Believe this product will last me a very long time as well, because I only use about two drops across my whole entire face. My skin absolutely loves this potentent, fast acting serum.

I ordered this and a few other antioxidants from TO. This is the smallest bottle out of all of the three. I use it a little heavy-handed as I like applying down my neck and to the back of my hands. There is transfer of the brown color to whatever you touch after you apply it. I don't know if I should continue using it though because when I apply it to my face, it heats my face up quite a lot. It doesn't burn but it gets hot immediately and I'm not sure what that means. The Euk 134 and Resveratrol also do this, to a lesser extent.

I loved this product and it worked on my skin. I haven't had much luck with The Ordinary products but I hit the jackpot with this one. I frlt a difference in just one application. My skin woke up baby smooth, plump and glowy. I need to buy a couple to have as extra because i dont want to run out. I definitely recommend.

I REALLY like this product, smell included, BUT I wish it came in the same size as the other serums, so the Niod pumps could be used with the bottles, instead of the unhygienic droppers. I hope customers' service reads this, and take my suggestion into account. Thank you.

I have gone through three bottles of this stuff. I love how it makes my skin feel, somehow softer and firmer. I feel this ingredient is underrated. I love to pair it with a vitamin C serum in the mornings, and occasionally after tretinoin in the evening when I'm feeling a little dry and need a little extra nourishment. I love the glow it seems to give, which I think is due to the hue. I truly pray that this product is never discontinued. I love having it as a stand-alone product for routine flexibility. Please never take this baby away.

I can't remember when I bought this but I have just finished it. This stuff is amazing. It makes my skin feel great and I love the smell! The greatest thing about this is that it doesn't cause any sensitivity for my skin at all. I suffered from an allergy reaction that absolutely stripped by face of its pigment and protective barrier. It made my skin super sensitive to everything including my tears. Even spf for sensitive skin was still causing a sting but this, this felt perfect! Honestly a truly unique product in my regime.
I heard about pycnogenol from a video raving about the effects of taking it orally as a supplement. I was curious if products used this ingredient and only this brand had it. The product is great!

This little bottle of goodness is incredible. Just a few drops applied before serums or lotion or mix in with your favorite products and boom! I saw a difference the next morning after my first application. It is red so careful with getting it in your clothes because it will stain. I use in combination with Augustinus Bader lotion and my skin is so smooth!

I bought this to replace the Copper peptides Buffet for economic reasons- I am so glad I did! I was looking for something with antioxidant support & read up on this product & was not expecting to see any results as I was just using it as a replacement. BUT THIS STUFF is amazing! I have acne-prone skin and texture and in 3 weeks my face is so smooth it feels like I shaved it. I use 4 drops every night after washing my face, let sit for 5 minutes, and then use my Cerave Moisturizing cream. I have never noticed this big of a difference with one product.

I have extremely sensitive skin that has been going through an ultra sensitized phase, and my skin has been tolerating almost nothing. The only things that don't make it break out right now are moisturizer, my prescription Adapalene gel, and this serum for some reason. My skin is really soft and glowy using this product every night. I haven't been able to tolerate any other antioxidants so I'm so thrilled that my skin not only finds this one agreeable, it does really well with it. I don't love the smell but I can ignore it. I wish it came in bigger bottles though! If you have very sensitive skin I would give this a shot, you might love it!!

I asked my friend for some skincare advice, since I was 40 years old and still using bar soap and no lotion on my face. I know, I know. She was actually appalled but impressed with how my skin was holding up. Anyways, this was the first TO product she turned me onto. I wasn't overly impressed, but I did like the other TO products I ordered. Ended up getting Amino Acid + B5 with my second order, which is a very sticky serum. Found that I could mix it with this and IT'S AWESOME! This somehow makes the Amino Acid less sticky, but allows both to absorb better. Anyways, my skin has never looked or feel better! I use Marine Hyaluronics, then 2 drops of this with 5 drops Amino Acid, followed by a good moisturizer (w/o HA). Works wonders! No breakouts, nothing but smooth skin. I also use Glycolic Acid 3x a week. Nothing but a light lotion during the day, use those at night, I am super happy! Definitely worth a shot!

I used this product through its completion and I'm not sure what I'm supposed to expect. I didn't notice any results but I didn't notice any changes. It did not break me out and the smell was not bad. I wouldn't purchase it again just because it's a small size and I feel there are more effective products to use.

Due to its texture and finish, I only use it in the evening, but a few drops added to your daytime cream should also work, unless you have very oily skin. As for the results, I can't really see any improvement in elasticity, but hopefully it will work as a preventative measure. Immediate results are usually more visable on older skin that tends to improve upon proper hydration. I'm in my early 30s and find that the most impressive results come from the TO Retinol 1% (clears up any congestion, improves texture, reduces fine lines - IF used with caution and moisturizer). I have a question to TO. Can I use Resveratrol and Pycnogenol together, possibly even mix it during application? Thanks for your help.

I have incredibly dry, textured skin and need an oil to mix into their moisturizer. The rosehip oil was fine (love it on my nails and hair) but kind of sat in top of my skin. Seabuckthorn made me look orange with my skin tone. This product was more than just right - it's perfect! Absorbs perfectly into my skin, leaves me with a nice glow that isn't orange, my skin feels plump and well hydrated without being greasy, and I personally love the woody smell. Will be buying again soon.

I've bought 3 bottle so far and I have to say this is one of the few skin care products I've bought that has had a noticeable and positive impact on my skin. I started to get questions and compliments about my routine after starting to use this. I prefer put it on in the PM every other night alternating between a retinol. I find that it works best after a shower when your pores are open. It works so well that I never feel the need to moisturize afterwards but I will put squalene on after on dry days. It does leave a minor tint on your face so keep that in mind if you want to put it on in the mornings. Also the reddish hue stains very badly so make sure not to drip it on anything. I wish they made a larger size. But I would have to recommend this product.

Not exaggerating here, but this might be the best skincare product I've ever tried (and this is a high bar because imo azelaic acid is the greatest invention of all time). Jokes aside, I was honestly blown away by the change I've seen after only using this for a fairly short time. My skin feels super smooth and plumper and the texture has improved a lot. It's also very hydrating. It doesn't do as much for active breakouts and fading scars than some other products from The Ordinary (the above mentioned azelaic acid remains king for that), but I'm getting to an age where I've started to feel I should be doing more to prevent future wrinkles and working on skin health and hydration, and pycnogenol is simply perfect for that. I wanted to use it in the morning, but the overnight effect is just too good to pass up on, so now I use it before RHS oil and NMF and wake up glowing. Hard recommend!

I use this in the morning only as I find my retinol products don't absorb well if I use it in the evening. I am really hoping it comes back in stock soon so I can stock up again! Any idea on how much longer this item will be out of stock for? Thanks!

So honestly I never leave reviews for anything ever BUT, I can't emphasise enough how quickly people should run to buy this serum! I saw this included in a skincare video of underrated products, and I couldn't agree more. I've been using a couple of drops twice a day with moisturiser for nearly a month and my face is reborn, it's never looked (or felt) so good & glowy. If I could take a bath in this stuff I probably would. It also smells like a deliciously earthy pine forest which I love, I know some people find the smell off putting but even then I'd say that's a small price to pay. I love so many of The Ordinary products but I've got no doubt that I'll probably swear by this stuff forever.

avis.titre: Great serum if you can handle the texture
avis.texte: I got this serum to replace my Estee lauder revatilize + bright. When I first applied this serum I wasn't a fan of the oily texture and because I've very sensitive skin I was sure I'd break out. To my surprise.. I woke up the next day with bright skin.. My acne marks/redness reduced drastically and my pimples were less painful. I've been using it only a week and I see a huge difference.
Beautiful serum, smells naturally good like tree bark, leaves my skin so soft! I apply just a couple drops after my Timeless Vitamin C serum, let it soak in, then follow with TO NMF cream.

I bought this product because of the reviews as well as esthetician recommendation. The smell is awful and it goes on my face with an orange tint, so night time use only. I didn't mind adding it to my night time regime but it does leave your pillow case with residue. But after a few months, the smell in the bottle got worse like it went bad. Open date said 12 months. Glad it was inexpensive because I tossed out over half the bottle. I like the ordinary products so I do plan to try a different antioxidant

I don't mean to oversell but please don't sleep on this product, the results are worth it. A little goes a long way - I just add a couple drops in with the Vitamin C powder and a squeeze of NMF and I'm glowing all day.

So this is the only squalane based thing I have bought from them because I hate the feeling of oil on my skin, as I have super oily skin already. Well, this product got me! I mostly bought it due to the glowing reviews for it on other products and I am so glad I did! I am only 23 going on 24 but noticed some slight wrinkling in my face (mostly forehead) and omg can I tell you how horrified I was to see signs of aging in the mirror! I also have acne but not very bad. Well after 5 days of use, my skin feels and looks SO MUCH TIGHTER, I have not broken out at all, which is surprising considering I started my period on it, and I am just in love. My forehead lines have not completely dissapeared but they have softened up! I am happy with that so far and it might get even better with continued use, it's a relief to me because I was freaking out thinking I needed to get botox ASAP (i probably still should). It apparently also offers some UV protection and I am going to order some pycnogenol as a oral supplement due to its studied medical properties. Like seriously look up how versatile this stuff is, helps your circulatory system, joint pain, mental clarity, etc. Not that this skin serum will do all that, but I cant believe I had never heard of this stuff before. What a GEM! I even started making my bf use it too I love it so much

I'd never heard of Pycnogenol and was watching a YouTube video with Rob from Mad About Skin where he was raving about it, so thought why not give it a go? I love it! I love the colour, the texture, the smell (it's not bad at all) and it makes my skin feel soooooooo good. I am particularly drawn to its antioxidant properties and I especially love how it stimulates the body to naturally produce Hyaluronic acid (Rob discusses this in the video) so it is plumping and hydrating from the inside out, not just the outside in when I apply my HA serum. I squeeze TO HA Moisturiser into the palm of my hand, then mix about 3 drops of Pycnogenal and smooth over my face and neck. Feels wonderful. This is the last step of my morning routine after serums and before sunscreen. Would definitely recommend this lovely serum!
I have been using this as part of my night time regime after for a couple of months now and my skin has never been in such good condition. I have received so many compliments!

avis.titre: This is underrated! Wish there was 60ml
avis.texte: Love how this makes my skin feel and mixing it with vitamin c serum. BTW I really wish TO would make an apocynin serum. Skin actives has a powder I use to put in my moisturizer but it's annoying, please make one!!

avis.titre: Like a hug for your skin
avis.texte: I use this after my water based serums and right before my oil based (usually the B all In one" or I combine with a favorite moisturizer. I've been using every night for over about 5 days and every morning my skin looks bouncy, fresh, and feels so soft and hydrated. I don't know how this wears under makeup so I haven't tested that out yet. It absorbs slow but you can feel yours skin drink it up. Love it and will be a part of my routine considering it's noticeable results when paired with other serums/ lotions Also I *literally* don't know what anyone is talking about when it comes to a "smell" It's neutral to me.

After learning the hard way that I am hypersensitive & reactive to Vit C, I discovered Pycnogenol. Can't beat the price of this The Ordinary's antioxidant powerhouse serum. I add apx 1/8 tsp of water toner, essence, or even water to 3-4 drops of Pycnogenol, swish in my palms, then pat to face, neck (front & back) decolletage, ears & backs of hands. Added to a watery base, it sinks in beautifully. Its kind of viscous & oil feeling using it straight & takes longer for absorption, which I do not have in the AM, so definitely recommend mixing in to something. I've never had pilling issues or any other adverse reactions w/any other products. SPF & make-up after, it's beautiful. And after apx 1 month, I noticed a brighter & healthier complexion, and I feel confident with it's extra layer of protection. Definitely worth a whirl.

avis.titre: Wasn't sure at first, now I love it
avis.texte: I added this as part of my skin cycling routine. In the mornings I add 2 drops of this to a vial, along with 1/2 - 3/4 scoop of their vitamin c L-Ascorbic Acid Powder. Then a tiny bit of warm water to dissolve the powder. Put my finger over the vial and shake. Perfect. My skin has never felt or looked better.

Makes my skin feel very hydrated and smooth . I use it in my am routine and often, i feel that i don't even need to apply moisturizer. Like someone else mentioned below, if i had to choose only one Ordinary product this would be it!
This product is amazing. Improved skin colour and firmness. Also reduced the appearance of my pimple scars… because I'm unfortunately a pimple popper.

I bought this a month ago, I am using it daily in the mornings, and I can already see a big improvement in my skin. My skin was dull and now it is much softer and brighter. For me, the smell is not a problem. It smells like a pine tree. I completely recommend this product, especially if you have sensitive skin as I do.

avis.titre: This with vitamin C is amazing!
avis.texte: I got this along with the ordinary ascorbyl glucoside 12%. I mix one drop of this, 2 drops of the 12% vitamin C, and add it to a simple hydrating serum of some sort. Mix them together in the palms of my hands then apply. My skin has NEVER been this smooth and beautiful. Love the combination of the two and I'm getting some amazing antioxidant and anti-aging benefits. A little goes a long way so the 0.5oz will last me a while!

avis.titre: Wish I'd Started Using Pychnogenol 5% Sooner!
avis.texte: I bought Pychnogenol 5% about 2 weeks ago, and I'm already noting such a difference. I have oily skin, but it has a hard time retaining moisture. Not anymore! A few drops (three) is all I need, and it leaves my skin looking and feeling amazing. The moisture *lasts.* And more than that, my skin looks plump and glossy, and the few fine lines I have are definitely minimized. It's especially noticeable around the hollows of my eyes and the tops of my cheeks. My skin has *never* looked better. After using this on my face (I mix three drops with a small dollop of Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA), I'll use the remainder on my hands, and I can't even begin to describe what a difference I've noticed there as well. I wash my hands a lot, and they also get dry very easily, even with regular moisturizing. But they look and feel so soft after I started including Pychnogenol 5%. It sounds crazy, but they look younger. Honestly wish I could dunk my whole body in this product. I'll try to do a check-in after a few months, but I needed to say how much I love and appreciate this product so far. I have sensitive skin, but I tolerate it without any issue. I don't leave reviews very often, but I felt I needed to for this. Some people complain about a smell, but I honestly don't notice anything, at least not with only three drops mixed into Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA. It absorbs well, too, so I haven't had any issues with staining. If I had to pick only one Ordinary product to use for the

I have very dry skin that is getting worse as I get older. It had gotten to the point where I could not wear foundation because no matter what I did, it looked cakey or would cause peeling due to the dryness of my skin. Until I found this stuff! This works so beautifully under make up, creating a nice smooth surface to apply to. My skin stays soft and never has that dry appearance later on anymore. In fact there's been a couple times I used too much and actually looked oily later on! That has literally never, ever happened to me. So highly recommend for dry skin. As far as other benefits, I haven't really noticed anything significant.

avis.titre: life saver of my sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is my third of bottle of this product. I recommend everyone with sensitive skin to try it. It only takes three drops and one night for you to witness the miracle.

It's really astounding how quickly this product works. My skin felt much smoother and more supple after only a week of use. And, just anecdotally, it seems to be a pretty potent antifungal and antibacterial compound as well., which is great for anyone with acne or folliculitis.

I bought this just to try it out and I like it so far. I would i recommend to use only one drop to get your skin used to it. I started with using two drops and my skin started to feel tight and dry. Aside from that I have less redness and my skin texture is going away.
I absolutely love this and it helps my skin as I work in the sun.

I have pretty normal skin that tends to be on the dry side. I had the worst allergic to this product. I went to bed and woke up with my face swollen and my eyes were almost swollen shut. It itched and the experience was horrible. Not sure what I did wrong. I will add that I do love the ordinary products and have never experienced anything like this before.

I can tell the difference right away when using this. I wear Tretinoin so my skin gets pretty dry most days so I use this as the very last step of my night time routine. I start my nighttime skincare routine pretty early around 7 or 8pm so most of the products before this has already seeped into my skin and it also means there is less chances of pycnogenol counteracting with other ingredients. I mix this with the ordinary's natural moisturizing factors just before bed and sometimes just on it's own and the next morning my skin feels so much smoother. It doesn't exactly make it more plumper but it does make it smoother and more elastic if that makes sense. The only issue is that if I stop wearing this the effects also go away so it's sadly something I need to continue to wear to see results and not something that actually fixes the skin permanently, as with most of ordinary's products.

avis.titre: I wouldn't buy for my skin
avis.texte: First let me say that there seems to be some confusion about what this is. Some reviews say the additive, Propanediol, is affecting them negatively. Propanediol IS pine bark extract. This product is just the one ingredient. Propanediol is extremely affective for a lot of skin types. There is nothing negative about the product itself, my skin is just too sensitive. I have Rosacea and it reacts to EVERYTHING. So, if you don't have SUPER TRIGGER SENSITIVE skin, this is worth a try. I know it DOES help those with Rosacea, so patch test it. My skin is just too bratty.

avis.titre: Glowing skin after the first use
avis.texte: I've been using The Ordinary products for years and this is the first time I'm writing a review as this product is absolutely amazing. You can see results after the first use. Skin is glowing. Plump and hydrated. Definitely will be a staple in my skincare routine.

I've used Pycnogenol for about 1.5 yrs so far, and I think my pores have actually shrunk to invisibility. The surface texture has improved and I have a healthy glow. It does get a little messy if you have white pillowcases, but a small price to pay for excellent results. I hope it works for you, too!

I love the ordinary products. Tried the pycnogenol and my skin started to immediately break out. It took only 10 minutes for painful acne to form. BUT my acne formed in places that I have been attempting to pop for weeks. Because of the pycnogenol I was able to finally pop my filled pores, so that was a plus. Although I am now dealing with the healing process of acne. Other than that the rest of my face felt great. I plan to continue to use the product for its "long term" benefits. But if it continues to break me out it will be returned…

avis.titre: Pairs really well with other products
avis.texte: I currently use this in the PM mixed with moisturizer after either retinol or vitamin C (I alternate days) with just hyaluronic acid and a light moisturizer on my nose and my skin is glowing it's so nice and I've noticed reductions in the fine lines on my forehead! Has a naturey kind of smell and I weirdly love that it's a deep red

My skin is glowing!!! Two drops goes a long way. I put this on with the rest of my skin routine at night, and my skin looks incredible in the morning. 15/10 highly recommend!!! If you want your acne scars to fade, plump skin, better texture- then buy this!! Be sure to use it correctly in your routine, and it will not disappoint. Do your research on what step to use this.

I tried this product by adding 1 spoon of LAA to 1 drop of Pycnogenol and 1 drop of Resveratrol. The product mixed instantly but dripped down my face. 2 hours later my face was like a chip pan. Next day I used this with 2 drops of Pycnogenol to LAA still would not absorb and dripping. Next day The same and the same after that. I gave up then I thought use without vit c as at time I was getting no benefit from vitamin c. I looked like an acne greaseball with red greasy irritated rash. Believing it was this product I then left it three days and another irritable rash. Tried product again and the same. I know it's rash as skin itching as soon as applied. I have very thick skin that is normal to oily with no sensitivities. So why can I max out on LAA and retinol with no probs but my skin repels this product then gets an itchy spoty rash with this gentle product. Simple my skin does not need it. It is not dry thin or suffering from elasticity issues. I believe skin is intelligent and lets you know what it needs. Try if suffering from dry skin that is thin or has a compromised barrier if not leave well alone.

Having extremely sensitive rosacea skin doesn't help...but this slightly burned by skin and turned it redder than it was already. I mixed a drop with my Soon Jung moisturizer but even that was too much. Probably won't try again and give this away.

Because of all the reviews mentioning the smell: I love this stuff, whenever I open the bottle it has this warm woody smell, to me it smells like a dry forest on a sunny day. It hydrates very nicely, I haven't noticed any other effects yet but it must be working under the radar for me. Only issue: I used it before granactive retinoid 2% once and immediately had a severe reaction (burning and redness). Ever since I've used it on alternate days, it didn't react with any other product.

This is made to work with your other serums. It's thicker; feels like a rich oil. Bright red in color! Helps hydration and psoriasis/ eczema on face. Love how soft my skin is! Only takes a couple drops

I brought this for the antioxidant purposes, but the unexpected side effect has been the hydration and softness my skin feels after using two drops once a day. I've been using prescribed tretinoin (.025%) for my cystic acne for 4 months now, and it has been drying my skin to the point of discomfort. Pycnogenol in combination with Amino acid B5 from the ordinary, and the larocheposay cicaplast cream has helped reduce the irritation and dryness without causing further acne. I would recommend pycnogenol for the hydration and glow, but if I am being honest, other than hydration, I have not seen any other dramatic differences on my skin for over two months. Hence the 4/5 instead of 5/5. No reduction on acne or very very slight reduction in hyperpigmentation. My favourite antioxidant from the ordinary is the resveratrol and ferulic acid 3% but it is drying unlike pycnogenol.

My skin is in love with this product! Helped with hydration and hyperpigmentation. And I absolutely love the way it smells: earthy and clean, just like fresh pine bark! I think, pycnogenol is one of the most underrated skin care ingredients. Thank you deciem for this beauty gem and great price! ❤

I started using it a couple of months ago. I don't know exactly what it does, but combined with marine hyaluronic serum my skin looks much better - more plump and youthful. A very unexpected side effect of using pycnogenol- when I apply it in the morning, after some time my face starts looking a little rosy - almost as if I spent some time in the sun. So I have no need to apply the self tanning drops anymore - my fair skin looks glowing and kinda tanned just by applying a few drops of pycnogenol.

avis.titre: Love it More Than I Thought I Would
avis.texte: I tried this after watching a YouTuber who recommended it and honestly I did not think I would love it as much as I do. My skin always looks plump and glows when I use it. I think I need to get a humidifier because my skin has been dryer this winter than since I can remember but this serum is the perfect addition for the last step of my routine. It's purpose isn't really to moisturize from what I've read but it seems to seal in my gel moisturizer without making my skin feel heavy or greasy. It does have an oil consistency but as someone who can't normally use any oils on my face, I have not had any problems with this making me break out. I will say for those who wear makeup, I would recommend using it in the evening or waiting to apply makeup as it does leave a slightly tacky texture for 20-30 minutes until it completely soaks in.

avis.titre: Love it! No issues with transfer or orange face!
avis.texte: Love this! I was a bit nervous that it would make my face orange or transfer to the pillow and it does not! Yes, it is orange, but I use 2 drops for my entire face and that works great! I love the way it makes my skin feel soft and prevents dryness. I am repurchasing because I can really feel the difference when I use this!

Skin type: normal with dry spots, not sensitive with occasional stress breakouts Climate: Canadian winter I bought this in November, and I usually add 2-3 drops to hyaluronic acid nightly in lieu of vit c. After the first night, my skin was dramatically softer and more supple in the morning. After three months of regular use, my skin looks brighter, glowy, and feels softer. The smell isn't noticeable since I'm using such a minute amount, but I've experienced a significant difference with its addition.

avis.titre: It makes my skin feels dry
avis.texte: I just started using this so this review might not reflect the real quality. Any advice for using it best? I see people's skin gets glowy and hydrated but not mine. My current steps are: Wash face > Toner > Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% > Pycnogenol 5% > TO moisturizer Right after Pycnogenol 5%, I feel like the products peel off and leave a sandy feeling. I follow the skincare regimen suggested to me but could it be my skin?

Just started to use it with LAA powder. Still need to wait a bit more to see if it does anything, but it's not causing any irritation for me. But I don't like the smell. It smells a bit .. sour?.. And it's quite strong to me, as I can smell it when it's on my face (gradually fades out though). But I will continue using it, and hopefully the smell is worth it.

I bought this profuct and i used it first zfter hylaruonic serum, and for couple days , after lactic serum in the night, as i have sensitive skin, i immediatly had buttons , irritations. I had the same thing with squalane serums that i had to return afterwards :(

I started having tiny whitehead breakouts after I started using this. I stopped using it, and the breakouts stopped. I tried again several weeks later hoping something else was the cause, and the next morning I had new blackheads again. I guess this is supposed to moisturize? I also didn't feel particularly moisturized when I used it. Love other Ordinary products, but this ain't it!

I decided I wanted to change up my entire skin care routine and did a lot of research on YouTube about the ordinary. I've tried their products in the past and wanted to branch out and try more. This was a product that I've heard from many Youtubers say was great for hydration. I have very dry skin and since after having my son I am a tiny bit combination just in my t zone but the slightest bit. I normally mixes with the ordinary voice Dreiser and I only use one drop. I will tell you all that this makes your skin have the most amazing natural glow you will ever have it leaves my skin feeling smooth as I am someone that has a lot of blackheads and pores around my chin mouth cupids bow and nose area it does a phenomenal job of leaving my pores smooth and my skin looking so incredibly juicy and healthy. Despite being a very small bottle it will last you a very long time if you are someone like me who uses one drop next with your moisturizer. I don't find there to be any crazy scent if at all and it does not leave my skin looking red when I mix it with my moisturizer.

avis.titre: This is what I was missing
avis.texte: I've had relatively healthy, mostly clear skin for about a year now after finally figuring out a skincare routine that works for me (Freeman's face masks helped a lot). However, I've kept some light acne scars that won't respond to any treatment, and I've still had discoloration. I got this serum for Christmas and it was my first time trying a serum at all, and it turns out this is the missing link my skin needed! After using it daily for about a week, my acne scars are a thing of the past and my skin tone is noticeably more even. Not to mention my skin is SOFT and PLUMP all the time. I've actually had a deep, non-acne scar on my forehead for the past few months, and I'm not kidding, this serum is making that scar fade before my eyes. My only complaint is that it takes about 20 minutes to fully absorb into my skin and putting makeup on over it doesn't work well until it's dry. Worth it :)

I tried this on a whim and so glad I did! The first time I used it I felt like my skin was firmimg up (if that is possible). I created a night routine of uskig Matrixyl 10+ HA, picnogenol and B oil and my skin looks so refreshed and dewy. I'm 47 and feel like it takes years off my face! As for the smell, I don't notice the smell at all.

I bought this because I really wanted some extra antioxidant protection in my routine and this is the first of The Ordinary's that I've tried. I've only used it a few times but I'm really impressed. It is a red colour and when I first put it on my face I looked like I'd been for a spray tan but this does go away as the serum sinks in. Overall my face looks brighter, healthier, feels smoother and it has a 'glow' to it which I love. It is a bit oily however which I was worried about as I do have combination to oily skin. I have found that mixing it in with a moisturizer and then applying helps it to sink in better.
I use 1 drop of pycnogenol mixed with the HA moisturizer-1 or 2 tiny drops &1 drop of HA 2%+B5 serum. mix it and dot it on. sinks in within a few min.

Added this to my morning routine and replaced my moisturizer with this. I applied a generous amount and give it about 20mins or so to sink in before sunscreen. This product works amazing for my skin making it feel soft and plump for and all day well hydrated feel. Also seemed to speed up the healing for a bad breakout I was still healing from slightly.

I'm so glad I decided to try the Pycnogenol, really like it. I feel like it calms the skin in some way, and yes, there is a glow. It's difficult to describe, but my skin just looks better. And I'm glad that it's doing more than just looking good. Versatile in that it's easy to mix/ layer with other products. It's like the icing on the cake with everything else I use. I barely smell anything unless I stick my nose right in it. Anyway I rather use something with an earthy, natural smell than fake, perfumey smell.

Wondering what type of propanediol is used in this and ferulic acid formula. Is it 1,2-Propanediol and 1,3-Propanediol (aka propylene glycol and propanediol, respectively)?? Which one? Where is your derived from? Thank you

I love the natural scent of this serum. This formulation is very calming to my skin. It has helped to sooth dry patches and my skin feels more hydrated and supple and redness is reduced greatly from using this. Can be used alone under a moisturizer or add a few drops to your favorite cream. Awesome and effective.

It's a very thick and bright red oil that smells oily. Once rubbed in my face and hands are super tacky and it doesn't absorb well. I started mixing it with my night time moisturizer and that helps. Probably won't purchase again.
I dont know if it actually does any goed. But I mix it in because it makes the skin colour cuter.

Not sure about the result yet. After reading all the wonderful reviews about it, I wanted to give it a try. I just use two drops AM and PM for two days and my face looks very red. I am Asian and my skin never looks so red before. Wondering why?

Me gusto mucho el producto, te deja la piel muy iluminada y posterior, suave. Lo utilizo solo en la mañana como tercer paso (Después hidratante y finalmente bloqueador) Antes aplicaba Alpha Arbutin lo que juntos dejaba la piel bien iluminada y tensa. Después que se me acabara el Alpha Arbutin, utilice Acido Hyaluronico, sin embargo, al ser este un serum en base de agua, al aplicar el Pycnogenol, dejaba en la piel pequeñas resinas, por lo que al menos, no los recomiendo juntos. Tengo piel grasa, por lo que recomiendo solo 2 gotas para el rostro completo, es muy concentrado. Lo recomiendo!
Embrace an aroma the way you learn to embrace a notch of the iPhone. It is amazing!

I have combo/sensitive skin. If your skin is going thru acne, a sunburn or an allergic reaction, the antioxidant properties of Pycnogenol will help. Pycnogenol is a powerful antioxidant. It's excellent for and skin (and the body (comes in oral supplement form). The bottle is small but it's expensive in the oral version as well. Love that it's availble in topical form.
Love this product! I apply this alone or mix it with my favorite brightening serum or Vitamin C. It plumps up my skin, makes it look like I had collagen injections. It's amazing.

I've started using this product mixed in hand with EUK and the results have been better than I could have thought! Also, pycnogenol makes my skin feel sooo nice and smooth. It's one of my favorite products from you guys!

So I originally ordered this product for my dyshydrodic eczema on my hands since I knew people were having success with it. I am happy to say it has helped better and faster than any prescribed medicated topical creams! I tried it on my face too and let me tell you it's never looked better. I have oily skin but felt like nothing kept it hydrated. I wake up with glowing skin everyday! I just wish the bottle was bigger for the price. It's like a quarter of the size of the ordinary's other serums but I need to keep getting it now!

I have bought many products from the ordinary and this is my favorite product by far. Goes on so smooth and really helps moisturize my skin like no other product I've tried. I feel like my complexion is so much better thanks to this, I always use it twice a day.
Makes my skin bright and soft and I know the long term effects of antioxidant protection will be great

avis.titre: Not for my oily sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I was extremely excited about this product but as soon as I put it on I started to feel it heat up and make my skin red. I also was not expecting it to be so oily and make my skin feel greasy. I wouldn't recommend this for oily sensitive skin types.

avis.titre: My skin has never felt so soft!
avis.texte: I have been using this for a bit over a month and I am in LOVE. My skin has never felt so soft. Even hours after application my skin still feels smooth and soft. I have been using this in the mornings : I mix a couple of drops with my Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA. If I am going to have a long day with makeup I will apply the Pycnogenol 5% (it will warm your face a bit but not hot and only lasts a few minutes) then seal it in with the Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA. I find this helps my make my skin stay soft all day even while outside with makeup on. My only tip is if you are applying it on its own, make sure it is fully absorbed before applying anything else. I have not had any issues with the colourstaining anything and I don't find the smell bothersome at all.

I use this sometimes in the morning mixed with the Vitamin C 23% or if I chose to use an exfoliating acid in the AM, I use it after that acid. So basically whenever I can't use my beloved EUK. And I must say, it really plumps my cheeks. Two drops are enough, especially in the summer more feel too oily. I also use Niod Survival 0 every morning and this contains pygnogenol already, but the plumping effect I only see with this product.

avis.titre: Coming back for my second bottle
avis.texte: This stuff is fantastic. I also take pycnogenol orally, and as a 51 year old woman, this is a great antioxidant plumper. The research on this stuff is fantastic, pycnogenol provides photoprotection and reduces hyperpigmentation. I'm an evidence based skin care junkie, and this has made a huge difference in my skin. I love the warming sensation, and find the smell piney and grassy, I find it pleasant.

I just recently bought this and have been using it for a week or so. Found many reviews suggesting the smell would be off putting. First thing I did was smell the product from the bottle, and, although it has a very mild vinegar smell in the bottle, once you apply it, it flourishes into a woody, molasses-like scent that reminds me of tree sap. My skin is feeling plump and full and firm and I'm totally in love with this product!

Immediately after applying you get this warm sensation, but the best part is your skin starts to looks so good after a few days of using this. I feel like I have this armor on my face that is protecting from all those free radicals that cause harm to your skin. Love this stuff and would recommend to everyone who is looking for an antioxidant serum for protection.

I bought this with high expectations. I use The Ordinary products and love them but this has proved no-no! I hardly ever get spots but have had breakouts since starting with this so am guessing its not suiting me. Tried to find customer contact section to email you for advice but couldn't! Disappointed as I had high hopes for this serum.

I decided to try new regime for my very dry skin- c-vit powder, buffet, pycnogenol and moisturizer AM and lactic acid10%, buffet, retinol emulsion and moisturizer PM and wow, my skin is visibly younger and lines on my forehead smoothed out. I have had a perfect skin for my whole life, no zits, small pores etc, but as my skin is very dry then unfortunately it has shown some signs of ageing in past years. I love the oily texture of pycnogenol, exactly what my dry skin needs to stay hydrated all day long. Love it.
I add this to my hyaluronic acid in the morning and niacinamide in the evening. Makes my skin look juicy and more plump. Will definitely keep this in the skincare collection.
